accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: BOHAN-PETA is committed to making this platform usable for everyone. This is an ongoing effort, and we welcome feedback.
accessibility.measure1: Full right-to-left (RTL) and left-to-right (LTR) layout support, with automatic text-direction detection for user-entered content.
accessibility.measure2: Keyboard-navigable forms with visible focus states and semantic HTML.
accessibility.measure3: Color choices checked for reasonable contrast against the background.
accessibility.measure4: A responsive layout that works on both desktop and mobile screens.
accessibility.limitations: This is a small, actively developed project and has not yet undergone a formal WCAG audit. Some screens may not fully meet AA-level standards. If you encounter a barrier, please let us know and we'll address it.
accessibility.contactText: If you experience any accessibility issue on this site, please reach out via
